# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 and HarfBuzz 14.2.0. It adds variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, modern sampling APIs, and new Linux and Tizen assets. Lifecycle, pixel access, font handling, and platform packaging receive substantial fixes. This is a breaking major release, so review the migrations below.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy paint, text, sampling, run-buffer, and backend APIs are compile errors** — Pre-v4 obsolete members are removed from the reference surface or promoted to error. Move text and glyph operations from SKPaint and SKTypeface to SKFont, pass SKSamplingOptions and SKTextAlign explicitly, use run-buffer span properties, and use backend constructors without sampleCount. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality are removed from the reference surface** — The obsolete enums no longer compile against v4 reference assemblies. Replace them with SKFontHinting and SKSamplingOptions. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **Default font and paint typeface semantics changed** — A parameterless SKFont or a null typeface now produces SKTypeface.Empty, while a new or reset SKPaint exposes SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default when text must render, and use IsEmpty rather than null checks for an unset typeface.
- **Missing family names now fall back on Android** — SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns SKTypeface.Default rather than null for a missing Android family. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when strict missing-family detection is required.
- **SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside the native range** — The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException instead of silently truncating values outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call Move(int). ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1** — Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context against Vulkan 1.0 can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to that same version; use another backend on 1.0-only hardware.
- **Vulkan backend interop layouts changed** — GRVkBackendContextNative removes fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2 where applicable. YCbCr conversion info also adds Components, so update manual struct initialization and native layout assumptions.
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion info uses the GR prefix** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Migrate from the obsolete GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo shim and replace reliance on its removed value-equality interface and operators. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject disposal protection is getter-only** — Derived wrappers can no longer assign IgnorePublicDispose. Update custom subclasses so disposal protection is established by the base wrapper lifecycle rather than mutating this property.
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8 or later** — Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The v4 engine update drops the EOL Tizen arm and x86 builds and packages. Move deployments to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m148** — Advances the bundled renderer from the 3.119 baseline through m148, including newer image-codec, HDR, wide-gamut, raster, filter, and runtime-effect behavior. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Bundled image, font, and compression libraries refreshed** — Updates libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, FreeType to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1, and libpng to 1.6.58. ([#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color fonts gain first-class APIs** — Adds variation-axis discovery and cloning, color font palette queries and overrides, HarfBuzz variation controls, and the correctly ordered HBColor value type. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **Animated WebP encoding added** — SKWebpEncoder can encode single images or timed frame sequences through span-based stream overloads. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Memory-backed streams expose their SKData** — SKStream.GetData returns ref-counted backing data when the native stream can provide it directly. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Sampling controls expanded** — SKSurface.Draw, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap gain overloads that accept SKSamplingOptions explicitly. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **New rendering and document APIs** — Adds SKPathBuilder, RF16 color data, CICP color spaces, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, and shader mask filters. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor offsets and shared-buffer stride** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap now calculate coordinates and span lengths from the correct axis and RowBytes, including extracted subsets. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Font span operations and glyph checks corrected** — Handles undersized variation buffers correctly and fixes a recursive ContainsGlyphs overload that could overflow the stack. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Android SKGLView resumes after navigation** — Preserves the current surface dimensions when a GL view is reattached after tab switches or page navigation. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **WinUI projection loads for .NET 9** — Packages the native projection assembly under compatible .NET 9 and .NET 10 runtime asset paths. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Apple library targets accept the base Xcode 26 workload** — Packages target the 26.0 platform versions instead of requiring Xcode 26.2. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton initialization and ownership hardened** — Lazily initializes process-wide wrappers, prevents shared native handles from being freed, and keeps managed wrappers alive across native calls. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility checks no longer run at assembly load** — Defers the compatibility gate until the first native call so applications can configure their native-library resolver first. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))
- **SKPath finalization no longer races its builder** — Prevents a finalizer-thread crash when an internal SKPathBuilder is collected before its owning path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution is more resilient** — Moves default-font lookup into the managed layer, avoids Android startup crashes, and uses an empty typeface when no system font is available. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **NanoServer starts without a system font manager** — Uses an empty font manager on NanoServer instead of crashing during SKTypeface initialization. ([#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets added** — Adds x64 and arm64 packages for Linux environments that use Android's Bionic libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen gains 64-bit native assets** — Adds tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 packages built against Tizen 8.0. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Security

- **Expat updated with security hardening** — Refreshes the bundled XML parser to 2.8.1, including upstream security hardening and entropy-source changes. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 updates the bundled shaping engine from 8.3.1.6 with improved OpenType shaping, CFF2 subsetting, and font-table handling. It also adds variable-font controls, color palette queries, HBColor, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.
